verdict.rationale: BigQuery's docs say it supports open table formats including Apache Iceberg, Delta and Apache Hudi. Iceberg managed tables keep data in customer-owned storage buckets, as a single copy that open-source and third-party engines can also use. A community user independently confirms BigQuery external tables can query object-storage data, comparing them favourably to Athena on S3. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of querying raw Parquet files, any detail on how Delta tables are queried in place, and documentation of external/BigLake table setup over object storage.
